newsitem.title: USA: CopyTele announces contracts worth $45 mln.
newsitem.headline: CopyTele announces contracts worth $45 mln.

text.p: CopyTele Inc on Wednesday said that it has entered into two distribution agreements for the sale and service of its personal communications product, MAGICOM 2000.
The aggregate purchase price for the total quantities contracted for sale under the two agreements is about $45 million, the company said.
Neither of the two companies involved in deals were named by CopyTele.

The first agreement is with a Brazilian distributor for distribution of the product in Brazil, the company said. The second agreement is with a Thailand distributor for distribution of the product in Thailand.
MAGICOM 2000 is a telephone-based product that can send and receive handwritten communications as well as simultaneous voice and electronic handwriting over a single telephone line.
